verdict.rationale: This is a fair question for a commerce platform, since vendors can publish AI-training policies or opt-outs for hosted services and telemetry. The evidence pack documents no AI-training opt-out, no training exclusion policy, and no data-use commitment about model training. The generic marketing line about 'full control... of your data' is an adjacent claim, not a documented capability to prevent AI training use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
